title: Deterministic complexity of set disjointness
statement: Let $n \geq 1$, and let $\mathrm{disjointness}(n, \cdot, \cdot)$ denote the two-party Boolean function that, given subsets $X, Y \subseteq [n]$ held by Alice and Bob respectively, returns $\mathtt{true}$ exactly when $X \cap Y = \emptyset$. Then the deterministic communication complexity of this function is exactly $n + 1$.
replaced:
For $n \ge 1$, the deterministic communication complexity of the set-disjointness
function on subsets of $[n]$ is exactly $n + 1$.
